title: Closing Visit and Transition Session Hold on Cancelled Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when the patient confirms the cancellation of an approved authorization counted in visits, hours or rental months, a closing visit is held for the provider's discharge assessment.

## Record read

The servicing provider's latest claim line among the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines (the latest by date of service) and how many days ago it is dated.

## Rule

| Authorization type | Servicing provider's latest line dated | Held from the release |
|---|---|---|
| a type that requires the patient to be homebound (the Home Health Care Authorization) | no more than 7 days ago | 1 visit |
| a type counted in hours (the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization) | no more than 7 days ago | 2 hours, for a transition session |
| any | more than 7 days ago, or no line | nothing |
| any other type | any | nothing |

In words: where the type requires the patient to be homebound and the servicing provider's latest claim line is dated no more than seven days ago, one visit is held; where the type is counted in hours and that latest line is dated no more than seven days ago, two hours are held for a transition session; otherwise nothing is held.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; cancellation confirmed on 20 May)

- Home Health Care Authorization, latest line dated 13 May (7 days before): 1 visit held.
- Home Health Care Authorization, latest line dated 12 May (8 days before): nothing held.
- Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization, latest line dated 18 May: 2 hours held.
- Rehabilitative Therapy Referral, latest line dated 19 May: nothing held.
